newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco C.bank withdraws 230 mln dirhams at auction.
newsitem.headline: Morocco C.bank withdraws 230 mln dirhams at auction.

text.p: Morocco's Bank al-Maghrib (central bank) withdrew 230 million dirhams from the money market for one week at its repurchase auction, a bank official said on Thursday.

The bank received bids totalling 4.748 billion dirhams and allocated 3.995 billion dirhams at 6.5 percent interest rate. That was less than the 4.225 billion dirhams leaving the market this week, the official said.
It satisfied 84.14 percent of the demand for liquidity.
The next auction is due on January 29, 1997.
